title: Inter should rotate half this team vs Club Brugge — Chivu, Stanković and six changes
description:
Inter host Club Brugge at San Siro today and Chivu should rotate half this team — here is why.
The Italian Inter press in English, free every morning: https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?ed=42

Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

CONFIRMED · Inter.it · Oct 12 — Chivu says "we'll make a few changes"; Çalhanoğlu is fit, Bastoni is available, Spence is training again.
CONFIRMED · Inter.it · Oct 12 — Shareholders approved the 2025/26 accounts: €518 million revenue and €22.7 million net profit, a second profitable year in a row.
REPORTED · Gazzetta dello Sport via FCInterNews · Oct 12 — six changes from the side that beat Parma, and a first Inter start for Aleksandar Stanković, who spent last season at Club Brugge.
REPORTED · Sky Sport Italia · Oct 12 — the same projected XI almost everywhere, but Çalhanoğlu in the deep midfield role instead of Stanković.
